description: This file defines a custom ILoggerProvider and ILogger implementation for integrating xUnit test output with the logging system.

classes.name: XunitLoggerProvider
classes.description: Implements ILoggerProvider to create loggers that write to xUnit's ITestOutputHelper.

classes.name: XunitLogger
classes.description: Implements ILogger and IDisposable to output log messages via the provided ITestOutputHelper.

methods.name: CreateLogger
methods.description: Creates a new XunitLogger instance for a given category name.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources; no implementation needed.

methods.name: BeginScope
methods.description: Begins a logical operation scope; returns itself as IDisposable.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the specified log level is enabled; always returns true.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message by writing to the ITestOutputHelper.
